name: Butyrfentanyl
metabolism: The main way it is broken down is by adding a hydroxyl group to the butanamide side chain and then oxidising that to a carboxylic acid. The version with the alkyl group taken off, norbutyrfentanyl, was not among the most plentiful products in human samples, but it was suggested as a good one to look for because it gives a strong signal.
summary: Butyrfentanyl is a short-acting synthetic opioid analgesic and fentanyl analogue that acts at μ-opioid receptors. It has been sold as a designer drug.
